# Matt L. Briselli (Matthew Lewis Briselli)

Chemistry; Dr. Veronica Hinman Evo-Devo Biology Lab), Production Stage Manager (25+ theatrical productions), flying trapeze catcher, and world traveler based in New York, NY.

## Professional Experience (Reconciled Across LinkedIn & Resumes)

### Google Photos — Technical Program Manager, Storytelling (L5, New York, NY)
*April 2025 – Present*
- Responsible for the **Photos Storytelling & Reminiscing Mission** within Google Photos.
- Leads cross-functional engineering to build and launch reminiscing and creation features including the **2025 Google Photos Recap**, **Memories**, and **Video Editing** across the Google Photos app and partner Google surfaces.

### Google Photos — Technical Program Manager, Foundations Client, Data Processing & Video (L5, San Francisco, CA)
*May 2022 – March 2025*
- **Ultra HDR Images (Oct 2022 – May 2025)**: Lead TPM in Google Photos on the joint Android (Media, Codecs, Graphics) and Pixel initiative. Secured leadership funding, drove engineering through the Android 14 default capture launch, championed ISO/TC-42 gainmap photography standardization, aligned Android OEM camera support ("Super HDR"), enabled iOS HDR sharing interoperability across backend/iOS/Android, and launched ML-powered SDR-to-HDR slider and AI editing support.
- **Cloud-Based Locked Folder (Jan – Oct 2023)**: Managed two teams (50 engineers) to expand local-only Android Locked Folder into an encrypted, cloud-backed cross-device feature across Android, iOS, and Web. Defined DAU and power-user logging metrics and led legal/privacy launches.
- **AI Video Key Moments & Video Infrastructure**: Partnered across Photos Android Infrastructure, HDR & Video Formats, and Pixel/Android teams to upgrade iOS, Android, and Backend video infrastructure and launch AI-powered Video Key Moments.
- **Google Healthy Award (Q1 2024) & Automated Bug Triage**: Won a company-wide Google Healthy award for leading a year-long Google Photos initiative recommending best-practice fixes that made writing tests easier; designed an automated bug triage process across Android and OEM partners and secured annual headcount.

### Google Maps — Technical Program Manager, Android Platform (L4 → L5, Seattle, WA)
*October 2020 – May 2022*
- **Google Play Data Safety Labels (Nov 2021 – Apr 2022)**: Created the two-pass codebase auditing process and release runbooks across Google Maps, Google Maps Go, and Navigation for Google Maps Go (NavGo). Led 100+ engineers auditing decade-old code in one month.
- **Material You & Android 12 Search/Navigation Widgets (Dec 2020 – Oct 2021)**: Led a 30-engineer cross-PA team from initial design and executive review through the Android 12 ("Snowcone" / SDK 31) launch of Material You dynamic styling and two resizable homescreen widgets (*Nearby Traffic* and *Quickly Find Places Nearby*).
- **Incognito Mode & System Performance**: TPM for Android and iOS Maps teams building and launching Incognito Mode; drove performance improvements across jank, startup/transition latency, and power/thermal metrics, and designed an integrated client-server testing framework.
- **Google San Francisco Culture Lead (Jan 2020 – Mar 2022)**: Managed a $160k budget for SFO tentpole events and community grants, leading hybrid and socially distanced programming through COVID.

### Google Maps — Software Engineer, Android Platform (L3 → L4, San Francisco, CA)
*October 2018 – October 2020*
- **Speakeasy Text-to-Speech (May 2019 Global Geo Hackathon Winner & Tech Lead)**: Built a 3-day hackathon prototype that swept Overall, People's Choice, and Site awards globally. Green-lit as a 20% project; served as Tech Lead (TL) for a 10-person cross-platform (iOS & Android) team over 9 months to launch local-language place and address pronunciation across 50 languages.
- **Maps 15th Birthday UI Redux & Traveler Localization (2019 – Feb 2020)**: Major contributing SWE overhauling tab-switching backstack logic and prefetching frameworks for the Go, Contribute, and Updates tabs; led an initiative redefining how Maps localizes travelers to fix years-old international travel bugs.
- **Caching Data Layer & Testing Oversight**: Led multi-team feature development and API reviews on a customizable caching data-layer and founded a testing oversight team.

### Adobe Systems Federal — Software Developer & Government Consultant (Tech Lead, Project Romeo, McLean, VA)
*June 2016 – September 2018 (2 yrs 4 mos)*
- Developed, implemented, and configured web content management solutions using **Adobe Experience Manager (AEM)** Sites, Forms, Assets, Communities, and Apps with Java, JSP, Sightly, HTML, XML, JavaScript, and web services.
- Served as Tech Lead on *Project Romeo*, constructing modular components emulating Microsoft Outlook (calendars, address books, task management) on an agile team meeting fixed federal customer deadlines.
- Awarded the **Sales Achievement Award** by Adobe Systems Federal (January 2017).

## Independent Development Projects
- **Arioso String Quartet (https://ariosoquartet.com)**: Full-stack Node.js/Express and static Cloudflare Workers/Firebase web platform maintained for his mother, violist Carol Briselli. Includes a 700+ piece interactive repertoire explorer, live availability inquiry pipeline, Schema.org JSON-LD graph, and `llms.txt` agent feeds.
- **Eat Brand Bite (https://eatbrandbite.com)**: Next.js 15 / React 19 / Tailwind CSS v4 fast-food & limited-edition CPG snack publication covering 136+ brands across 19 live feeds, featuring a weekly rotating *Specials On Now* board (Crumbl, PopUp Bagels, Insomnia Cookies, Krispy Kreme, Jeni's, etc.) with countdown badges, live Cloudflare D1 reactions, and Google-verified AI-moderated comments, automated Buffer multi-platform publishing (Bluesky, Instagram, Threads), *The Weekly Bite* Kit newsletter, and `llms.txt` / JSON-LD agent feeds.
- **GamerBoy Solitaire (https://github.com/MattBriselli/GamerBoy)**: React Native (Fabric) + Expo (TypeScript) iOS & Android Klondike Solitaire game featuring a heuristic solver guaranteeing 100%-solvable winning deals, deterministic daily challenges, and a 52-card persistent animation engine (concurrent flight arcs, 3D flips, spring snap-back, and deal cascades).
- **Personal Atlas & Film Archive (https://mattbriselli.com / https://github.com/MattBriselli/mattbriselli.com)**: Zero-framework personal site on Cloudflare Workers Static Assets rendering 10,796 privacy-geofenced travel and photo pins on shared HTML5 Canvas (automated 7-day rolling embargo across Google Maps, Flighty, and Foursquare Swarm), 1,422 cached Letterboxd reviews + 12 curated `2:3` poster lists, and `llms.txt` / `resume.json` agent feeds.

## Science, Education, Theatre & Circus Arts Background
- **Carnegie Mellon University (B.S. in Chemistry, Mellon College of Science, 2012 – May 2016)**:
  - Awarded **Senior Leadership Recognition** (June 2016).
  - **Undergraduate Research Assistant in Dr. Veronica Hinman's Evolutionary & Developmental Biology Lab** (Nov 2013 – Jan 2015, Mellon Institute of Industrial Research): Performed gene knockdowns on the fully sequenced genomes of the Sea Star and Sea Urchin to study regeneration and developmental traits.
  - **Shanghai International Studies University (Summer 2013)**: Studied Mandarin Chinese for Oral Communication and The Structure of Chinese in Shanghai, China.
  - Coursework and project work in Computer Science, Scenic Design, and Acting.
- **Camp Cayuga — Flying Trapeze & Circus Arts Counselor (Summers 2014 & 2015, Honesdale, PA)**:
  - Worked on the board of the flying trapeze rig, caught trapeze flyers, taught and performed on lyra (aerial hoop), and taught circus arts (juggling, diabolo, devil sticks, spinning plates).
- **Greek Sing Chair (Delta Tau Delta, May 2013 – May 2016)**: Produced and performed in 13-minute abridged Broadway musicals (*Wicked*, *American Idiot*), raising over $200,000 for Pittsburgh charities.
- **AB Films Projectionist (Aug 2013 – Apr 2014)**: Projected $1 movies in the college auditorium and led the acquisition of a new $30,000 theatre-quality projector for Carnegie Mellon.
- **Theatre Production Stage Manager, Director & Actor (25+ Productions)**: Stage Manager for *The 25th Annual Putnam County Spelling Bee*, *Bat Boy*, *Guts*, *Hi-Rise*, *The Drowsy Chaperone*, *All in the Timing*, *The Government Inspector*, *Urinetown*, and *Little Shop of Horrors*; Assistant Stage Manager for *Assassins*; Director of *The Rocky Horror Picture Show* shadow cast at CMU.
- **Clinical Volunteering**: Hospital of the University of Pennsylvania (2011–2012, Neurosurgery ward & Abramson Cancer Center GI Oncology) and UPMC Shadyside (2013, shadowing anesthesiology & internal medicine residents).
